duration.value: 1 round (last until the end of the caster’s turn) DESCRIPTION When you cast this spell, you disappear into the shadows. This spell functions like vanish , except the effect only lasts until the end of the caster’s turn. Like vanish, the spell immediately ends if the subject attacks any creature.
